none.$description: Raw scale, no meaning attached. Explicit zero — flat/square corners.

max.$description: Figma variable name: radius/full. Renamed to `max` in this file only — Style Dictionary merges all token files into one flat path tree (unlike Figma's collection-scoped namespacing), so this primitive can't share the exact path `radius.full` with the semantic radius.full role below, which deliberately reuses the same name as its Figma counterpart. See governance/decisions/0006-radius-token-architecture.md. Deliberately oversized so it always resolves to a full capsule/circle regardless of element size — not a real measurement.
